_comment: Hand-kept lists (element symbols). build.py asserts the expected counts, so an accidental edit fails loudly.

discovery_year_overrides._comment: Elements known since antiquity, where Wikidata gives no date.

named_place.note: Named after a place: a village, city, region, country or continent.

named_celestial.note: Named after the Sun, the Moon, the Earth, a planet or an asteroid.

named_myth.note: Named after a mythological figure or creature.

named_colour.note: Named after a colour (usually the colour of a flame or spectral line, in Greek or Latin).

latin_symbol.note: Symbol comes from a Latin or other old name, not the English one.

essential.note: Essential to human life, including trace elements.

synthetic.note: First made in a laboratory rather than found in nature.

discovered_sweden.note: Discovered in Sweden (Finland was Swedish when yttrium was found there).

discovered_russia.note: Discovered in Russia or the Soviet Union, including the joint Dubna discoveries.

discovered_woman.note: A woman discovered or co-discovered it: Marie Curie, Marguerite Perey, Ida Noddack, Lise Meitner.

precious.note: Precious metals: gold, silver and the six platinum-group metals.

crust_top10.note: The ten most abundant elements in the Earth's crust.

air.note: Present as a gas in dry air (not counting carbon dioxide).
